key_insight: Physics-informed neural networks can optimize single-qubit gates at the level of the full quantum evolution, jointly learning control fields, state trajectories, and gate duration under the Bloch equation.
engineering_relevance: This makes quantum gate synthesis more physically interpretable and adaptable, helping engineers diagnose, refine, and deploy hardware-specific controls without relying on preset pulse shapes or duration scans.
method: PINN-based joint optimization of pulse amplitudes, Bloch-state evolution, and total gate time
Physics enforced through the Bloch equation to make the learned process physically consistent
Applied to rotation gates and a geometric gate to inspect structure and improve local residual errors
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that optimized rotation gates recover expected bounded-control structure, and the geometric gate refinement reduces residual path error while keeping high fidelity.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate physics modeling and may be sensitive to optimization quality or model mismatch when transferred to real hardware.
paper_title: Evolution-Level Quantum Optimal Control of Single-Qubit Gates with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
